newsitem.title: USA: Three firms win $40 mln of Stamford, Conn., BANs.
newsitem.headline: Three firms win $40 mln of Stamford, Conn., BANs.

text.p: Three firms won $40 million of Stamford, Conn., bond anticipation notes (BANs), each with a with a four percent coupon and differing net interest costs (NIC).
Dillon Read won the lionshare of the notes, taking down $28 million with a four percent coupon and a 3.6412 percent NIC.
First Union Capital Markets won $10 million with a four percent coupon and 3.6313 percent NIC.
And Bank of Boston won $2 million with a four percent coupon and a 3.626 percent NIC. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
